categories.main_business_segments: JinLei Technology primarily operates in the wind power industry, focusing on manufacturing wind turbine main shafts and other core wind power components. The company also extends its product offerings to other high-end forged and cast components serving industries such as hydropower, shipbuilding, mining machinery, and heavy equipment manufacturing. Its business is structured around two strategic segments: wind power equipment core components and diversified high-end forged and cast parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including purified steel smelting, fully sealed casting, near-net-shape hollow forging, and automated intelligent coating. It has developed proprietary techniques such as large-diameter hollow forging for high material utilization and efficiency, new flow inoculation technology for castings to enhance impact resistance, and automated spraying technology to improve coating quality. JinLei also emphasizes continuous R&D in forging, heat treatment, machining, and surface treatment to maintain technological leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JinLei serves global wind turbine manufacturers, holding a leading market share in forged wind turbine main shafts. Its customers include major domestic and international wind turbine OEMs. Beyond wind power, it supplies precision shafts and castings to hydropower, shipbuilding, mining machinery, cement equipment, and other high-end manufacturing sectors. The company maintains a balanced domestic and overseas customer base, with nearly one-third of revenue from exports.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant production facilities in Shandong Province and subsidiaries in other regions. It also has established overseas presence through a subsidiary in Singapore to support international market expansion. Its sales and operations cover both domestic and international markets, with about 32% of revenue generated from overseas customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: JinLei operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of critical wind turbine components such as main shafts, hubs, bearing seats, and bases. It controls the full production process from steel ingot smelting, forging, casting, machining to coating, enabling vertical integration and quality control. The company also supplies to downstream OEMs and indirectly supports upstream raw material suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in large-scale wind turbine components, especially adapting to the trend of wind turbine large-scale and offshore development. R&D focuses include high-purity steel ingot technology, hollow forging, heat treatment optimization, automated coating, and precision machining. JinLei actively collaborates with research institutes and universities to accelerate technology development and industrial application. It also invests in digital manufacturing and smart production to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: JinLei generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products, including forged and cast wind turbine main shafts and other precision shafts and castings. The company operates a direct sales model without intermediaries, serving OEMs and industrial customers. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, typically at shipment or delivery points.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JinLei is a global leader in the wind turbine main shaft market, holding the top market share in forged main shafts. It competes with other domestic and international manufacturers of wind power components and high-end forged and cast parts. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, full-process control, and strong customer relationships, positioning as a preferred supplier for major wind turbine OEMs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, JinLei reported operating revenue of approximately 1.97 billion RMB, a slight increase of 1.11% over the previous year. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 58.03% to about 173 million RMB, mainly due to intensified market competition and the ramp-up phase of new offshore wind power digital manufacturing projects. The company maintains total assets of about 6.65 billion RMB and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JinLei emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and technologically advanced wind turbine components that meet the demands of large-scale and offshore wind power projects. Its unique value lies in proprietary forging and casting technologies, full-process manufacturing control, and strong R&D capabilities. The company offers customized solutions with superior mechanical properties, efficiency, and durability, supported by comprehensive quality management and after-sales service, enabling customers to reduce costs and improve operational stability.
